verdicts.reason: The two layouts are identical, and both have the same flaw: the photo panel no longer fills the canvas height. It sits inset, with dark bands of about 15px above and below while running flush to the right edge, so it looks like a letterboxed leftover rather than a deliberate rearrangement. The left column also leaves extra empty space below the CTA. A breaks the headline better ('Your coffee, / on repeat'), while B keeps the original's awkward break that leaves 'on' dangling at the end of line 1, so A edges it.
